info.name: Microsoft Graph Admin Admin.admin users.directoryObject API
users.directoryObject
Microsoft Graph List a user's direct memberships

params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Get groups, directory roles, and administrative units that the user is a direct member of. This operation isn't transitive. To retrieve groups, directory roles, and administrative units that the user is a member through transitive membership, use the List user transitive memberOf API.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Get memberOf from users

items.docs: The groups and directory roles that the user is a member of. Read-only. Nullable. Supports $expand.
